reaction: It was satisfying to see the temporary clot replaced by repaired tissue rather than treated as the final repair.

mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the surface and then adding deeper support and blood supply showed that healing involves more than covering the cut.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making each replacement part separately was a little repetitive, even though the pictures made their jobs clear.

surprise.text: The surface closed before the deeper tissue was fully supported, and the clot was cleared only after the new blood route connected.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and named slots explained where the parts belonged.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following the same wound from clearing through repair made the separate steps connect into a story.
